typeCode.name: Animal In Trap Complaint
typeCode.phase: Use this service request to report an animal in a trap. Do not use if the animal is loose inside a house or building. Do not use this service request to report animals confined in boxes or carriers – use Stray Animal call type instead. If the animal is in a private trap CACC will not pick it up. The caller must make arrangements via internet/email at visitcacc@cityofchicago.org to bring the animal to CACC. Callers without a valid state issued permit will have the trap confiscated (i.e., not returned) & may be referred to the state for illegal trapping for possible fines.

typeCode.name: Bee/Wasp Removal
typeCode.phase: This type code is for bee and wasp removal. Note: The City does not remove nests from private property/dwelling/back yards.

typeCode.name: Dead Animal Pick-Up Request
typeCode.phase: This type service request to report a dead animal that needs to be picked-up and removed.

typeCode.name: Dead Bird
typeCode.phase: This type code is for tracking dead birds, especially as they relate to the West Nile Virus.

typeCode.name: Stray Animal Complaint
typeCode.phase: Use this service request to report a stray animal. A stray animal is an unleashed animal not in the presence of an owner and does not pertain to wildlife which cannot be defined as strays. If the animal is wildlife CACC will not respond unless the animal is injured or vicious as it is protected by state wildlife codes/laws.
